heading: Sunday Night
text: Widespread rain spreading northeast, with a chance of early thunderstorms. Lows in the low to mid 60s, a few 50s in the cold spots. Light south wind.

heading: Monday
text: Heavy early morning showers, drying out west. Chance of afternoon thunderstorms from the Green mountains east. Highs from the upper 70s to low 8t0s. Wind turning southwest at 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Monday Night
text: Clear skies developing overnight as showers diminish west to east. Lows from the upper 50s to near 60. Light and variable wind.
